meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Ultra-compressed commit message generator. Cuts noise from commit messages while preserving intent and reasoning. Conventional Commits format. Subject ≤50 chars, body only when "why" isn't obvious. Use when user says "write a commit", "commit message", "generate commit", "/commit", or invokes /caveman-commit. Auto-triggers when staging changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把暂存变更压缩成简洁的提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次写提交信息都要纠结很久
copy.tagline_en: Compress staged changes into concise commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to write clear commit messages

howto.what: 安装此技能后，当你要求写提交信息时，Claude 会生成符合 Conventional Commits 格式的极简提交信息。主题行用祈使句，尽量不超过 50 字符；只在原因不明或涉及破坏性变更、安全修复、数据迁移、回滚时添加正文。
howto.when: 当你说“write a commit”、“commit message”、“generate commit”等指令，或调用“/caveman-commit”，或在暂存更改时自动触发。

say.text: 用 caveman-commit 风格生成提交信息
把暂存区改动整理成提交信息
say.note: 基于暂存区生成提交信息

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates terse, exact commit messages in Conventional Commits format. Subject ≤50 chars; body only for non-obvious reasons, breaking changes, security fixes, migrations, or reverts.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like 'write a commit', 'commit message', 'generate commit', or invocation of /caveman-commit; also auto-triggers when staging changes.

say_en.note: Creates a commit message from the diff
